limitations: The historical MTP comparison has a different activation from the fresh final r4 candidate.
C16 is not cross-arm comparable: MTP effective active cap was 9 while no-spec was 16.
C1 context timings overlapped coding work and are quality-only, not isolated performance evidence.
C2 proves two overlapping application requests only to the extent captured by its retained engine samples; it does not establish hypothetical full-residency capacity.
The original overlap stability artifact remains immutable failed coverage evidence; successors use a separately pinned inspector source and contender-stream-active/v1 contract.
The initial independent stability review raised a source-digest-method finding; its retained correction accepts the exact run-cell package method without an additional replay.
Fresh final capacity is a separate 10-cell, 72-request population and is not pooled with the historical 60-cell matched comparison.

The selected 32K C2 operating point is a concurrency tradeoff: decode p50 13.43 tokens/s is below the 15 objective, while first-output p95 is 16.69 seconds under the 30-second bound. C1 is the latency-first option (63.44/62.46 decode p50 at 8K/32K).
The completed SWE result is a fixed five-task campaign floor, not a broad coding benchmark population estimate.
Current deployment, routing, aliases and client assignments are outside this public record.
